strings.JAP_THENEWORDER_DESC: The sun never sets on the Japanese Empire, or at least it hasn't yet. Reigning over the single largest population of any nation on Earth, the Japanese maintain the largest military, industrial base, and navy in the world. With treaty ports in America and ownership of the Pacific, Japan has gone from a shut in nation behind the Europeans to the masters of the sea and land. All is not well, however, as the increasingly byzantine Imperial Court constantly undermines the monarchy, and the more Japan uses China's resources, the more their grip on the colonies slip.
strings.JAP_emperor_hirohito_override_instant:
While Japan's civilian government is led by {jap_keisuke_okada}, the revered head of state, Hirohito, represents the embodiment of power within the nation.

Numerous factions vie for Imperial Influence so long as the Empire remains intact.
strings.JAP_Subcontinental_Crisis_buildup_desc: While the American puppet state in India has been cast down and destroyed by our Hindustani friends, Germany's puppet state in India is alive and well - but if we have our way, it will be neither, soon enough. Should “Pakistan” continue to exist, it will open up all of Asia to German intervention. We must give full backing to our Hindustani allies and force Germany to abandon the idea of a Pakt member state in Asia - by hook or by crook.
strings.JAP_Subcontinental_Crisis_confrontation_: While the American puppet state in India has been cast down and destroyed by our Hindustani friends, Germany's puppet state in India is alive and well - but if we have our way, it will be neither, soon enough. Should “Pakistan” continue to exist, it will open up all of Asia to German intervention. We must give full backing to our Hindustani allies and force Germany to abandon the idea of a Pakt member state in Asia - by hook or by crook.
strings.JAP_SC_stoke_fears_of_war_in_german_medi:
If Pakt Readiness is high, it will decrease by 30%
But if Pakt Readiness is low, the decision will backfire and it will increase by 35%
strings.JAP_SC_bump_german_warship_tt:
If Pakt Readiness is below 50%, it will decrease by 30%
But if Pakt Readiness is above 50%, the decision will backfire and it will increase by 35%
strings.JAP_SC_stoke_fears_of_war_in_german_medi: Stoke Fears of War in German Media
strings.JAP_SC_deescalate_desc: This is getting out of control. We cannot let a war break out at any cost.
strings.JAP_delay_the_conference_desc: Things have not progressed in a way we want them to. To this end, we will pressure non-aligned delegates to delay the conference in any way they can. This will drastically increase suspicion.
strings.JAP_bribe_officials_desc: By turning delegates and officials against each other, we can decrease the suspicion against our agents - something that can only help us further our goals.
strings.JAP_remove_foreign_influence_desc: Using our tallest intelligence agency, we can bribe, threaten, and blackmail delegates into supporting our wishes - they know what will happen if they don't.
strings.JAP_blow_it_up_desc: Our plan is ready for action - and the sword is ready to strike.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.1:
Jealous of the Colonial Empires possessed by the Europeans and snubbed by the failure of the Racial Equality Clause in Versailles, the Empire of Japan sought to carve its own Imperium within the resource-bountiful but troubled region of East Asia. With the fall of the hated Washington Naval Treaty, it was only a matter of time. Occupying Manchuria - sealing the dead Tsar's bitter rout in 1905 once and for all - in 1931, it reorganised the region into the Empire of Manchuria or simply, Manchukuo. The Kwantung Army - had seized Manchuria from the warlords and fiefdoms that had been vying for even scraps of power within its wind-swept hills, when an explosion rocked the Japanese-controlled Mantetsu.

Within the backdrop of the Great Depression an ultimate clash for the fate of the entirety of Asia lay over the horizon. When the dark sky broke, a war like no other would erupt.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.2: On the 7th of July, 1937, the war against China had entered a new, savage phase. Japanese forces had cut their way through the Chinese troops in what was named the “Marco Polo Bridge Incident”. While some observers had dismissed the battle as another round of aggressive posturing by Tokyo, it was the first shots of what would become Japan's complete takeover of China. The “Chinese-Japanese War”, the “War of Resistance” or the “Second Sino-Japanese War” are only some of the names that describe the Empire's invasion. However, to those that lived and died through it, only one could encapsulate the conditions of the struggle. Hell. Stiff Chinese resistance - in no small part due to the armistice that leaders Mao Zedong and Chiang Kai-shek had signed - prompted Japan to take crueller measures to tame the land they occupied. Burning, looting and maiming any perceived source of resistance, millions would be sacrificed to Japan's aspirations for resources and Pacific Hegemony.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.3: When the war bogged itself down, Japan turned its gaze to the colonial holdings of the West, to prop its War Economy up. A decisive surprise strike against the American Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbour coupled with blinding pushes into the South-East Asian holdings of the Netherlands, France and its old ally - Great Britain - shattered their perceived racial superiority against the Japanese Army. One by one, their prized strongholds failed to protect them against the Rising Sun's rays. Singapore, Manila, Batavia, Hong Kong were only a sample of the Western failure to outwit and outgun the Imperial Japanese forces. The Americans, once more, were subject to a fierce defeat at the Battle of Midway while the forces of the British Empire failed to contain the offensives in Papua New Guinea - with Australia now in striking distance.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.4:
Despite the heroic efforts of the “United Nations” in Asia - the Chinese states, Britain and its Empire and America - they could not hope to match the war machine inside the Home Islands. Despite resounding reverses by the American Navy and the Anglo-Chinese forces drawing the overextended IJA forces to bloody stalemate, it was all for naught. Both Mao Zedong and Chiang Kai-shek were last reported making a last stand within the fortress-city of Chongqing. Due to the pitched hand-to-hand fighting within the city, nobody is quite sure how or when the warlords were killed.

America was the last to kneel to the combined forces of the Axis. Despite the two navies dealing crushing blow for blow, America was isolated. Yet, the worst was to come. On one sunny morning over Pearl Harbour, a singular bomb was dropped on Hawaii that would gouge a deep scar across the face of humanity. Forever.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.5:
The Atom Bomb did not, could not and would not discriminate. Man and Beast alike were incinerated in the blast - with even the famous Admiral Nimitz and Admiral Halsey vapourised within seconds. Where women and children played, only a thin layer of black covering the ground mourned their death.

What the Atom Bomb did do, however, was end the largest war ever fought. The faltering public spirit collapsed entirely, and convinced the people to sign for an armistice. Manchukuo was recognised as a formal state. China itself was reconstructed into a series of vassal states, the largest of these being the “Reorganised Government of the Republic of China” with other states such as the “State of Guangdong” being plucked from the remains to serve Japanese interests. Now in 1962, Asia is only a hair's breadth away from complete Japanese domination.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.6:
What kind of Japan will the Shōwa Emperor leave behind? Given name being Hirohito, his start was heralded by an assassination attempt on his life in 1932. Moreover, the Shōwa Emperor now had the Great Depression to deal with, only speeding the militarisation of Japanese society underneath the continent-spanning dreams of its generals and Prime Ministers. Emperor Hirohito's task was to act as a uniting figurehead that guided all of his subjects through turbulence and chaos. But now, the Shōwa Emperor is getting old and reclusive. Those who do manage to sneak an encounter with him talk of his erratic behaviour or his increasing indulgence in his pursuits. Seemingly, Japan is ruled by Hirohito but is not being led by the Shōwa Emperor.

Yet, given Japan's near miraculous victory against all that was thrown against it, perhaps Divine Fortune did shine down on him after all.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.7: The Imperial Rule Association or the Imperial Aid Association - romanticised from its native tongue as the Taisei Yokusankai - is an unemployed servant, to put it callously. Created on the 12th of October, 1940, the organisation was the crowning apex of a Premiership gone badly wrong. The grand masterstroke of Prime Minister Fumimaro Konoe, the Taisei Yokusankai was smithed from Japan's need to streamline the process of war-making, in order to break the stalemate that had settled over many parts of China. Espousing a “one nation, one party organisation” policy, Konoe, along with his private research trust the Shōwa Kenkyukai, established a framework where every party inside the Japanese Diet would be resettled into a coalition that would co-ordinate the ongoing war effort without petty squabbling and bitter interpersonal rivalries clouding the judgement of its military leaders. Despite the seemingly unanimous government, to say that the YSK are united...
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.8: Jockeying for power inside Japan there are four main factions. There are the Reformists, led by war hero Sōkichi Takagi, who favour liberalisation within Japan to save it from structural rot. Then there are the Conservatives, led by Ino Hiroya and his second-in-command, Ikeda Masanosuke who wish to maintain course and patch the holes inside the Japanese political scene to maintain its strength abroad. Following them, there are the Technocrats, led by Kaya Okinori. They demand that Japan becomes a ruthless meritocracy controlled by an elite group of specialists in order to maximise Japan's potential in Asia and make sure it punches above its weight. Finally, there are the Kidoites. While not numerous enough to be its own faction, they are the Kingmakers inside the Diet - due to their eponymous leader, Kido Kōichi's relationship with the Emperor as Lord Keeper of the Privy Seal. All these factions must be dealt with for a government to succeed.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.9: The Shōwa Emperor is the Heart of the Empire, the Taisei Yokusankai is the Mind of Japan but the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy are the Swords and Shield of the great Pan-Asian Project that protect them both. The pride of the entire nation, hundreds of thousands of men ready to lay down their lives in service of the nation and its hallowed institutions of “Co-Prosperity”. Yet, victory has made the IJA and IJN fat with arrogance. While nowhere near the levels of influence and rivalry as during the 1930's and 40's, the IJA and IJN still duel each other for both funding and attention within the government. Any functioning government will need to try its best, not to just keep the military's sticky fingers from interfering with the agenda, but also to make sure that neither faction is favoured too much. Paranoia, after all, is a powerful thing in politics...
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.10:
The current ruling faction inside the Taisei Yokusankai, the Conservatives, are led by Prime Minister Ino Hiroya and his second-in-command, Ikeda Masanosuke. While - due to their status quo positions - they are the most popular of the factions inside the YSK. While criticised by other factions for allegedly turning a “blind eye” to structural and systematic issues inside the Empire, the Conservatives promise to stabilise the political chaos that has ravaged Japan for so long.

Traditionalists, they throw themselves into a similar camp as the old Tories inside the British Empire, and emphasise a Co-Prosperity Sphere that prioritises intra-factional trade and high tariffs put upon foreign goods. While some may accuse the Conservatives as paramedics attempting to put a bandage on a stab wound, there is no doubt they would have the easiest time enforcing their agenda.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.11: A Dark Horse, the Technocrats - lead by former Finance Minister, Kaya Okinori - demand for Japan to be a well-oiled machine that is only run as the most ruthless meritocracy on the planet, if they want to stand a chance against their enemies in the so-called Cold War. Distrusted, even by the other factions inside the YSK, their power mostly relies on the vice-like grip they have on the bureaucracy.If allowed to come to power, they will pursue total governmental control over the nation - with increased centralisation measures across the country. Moreover, this power will be concentrated inside an elite clique of political officials and bureaucrats that will dictate Tokyo's rule, even over the megacorporations and Zaibatsu. Even for the outsider factions, Kaya's government will need all the help it can get to enforce its will on Asia.
strings.JAP_CountryInfo_Content_desc.12: Centred on its eponymous leader, Kido Kōichi, the Kidoites aren't so much a faction as they are kingmakers. Kido, being the Lord Keeper of the Privy Seal, acts as His Majesty's eyes and ears inside the government - as well as his supposed mouth. If Kido says something must be or must not be done, it is only because the Emperor said it must be or must not be done. At least, allegedly. His support will be instrumental, in getting any potential government's legislation through the House of Representatives as well as the small gathering of allies he has accrued inside the YSK that equally enjoy being the tiebreaker inside politics as he does.
strings.JAP_congo_civil_war_desc: The Congo has fallen to chaos, and with the Americans and Germans trying to control the remains, it falls upon us to deny these imperialists the benefits of the Congo. Our victory in the Congo will solidify our influence, and continue to deny Africa to our enemies.
strings.JAP_SHO_aid_category_desc:
Shōnan has been one of our most problematic colonies for a considerable amount of time. Ever since we plied it off the British hands, while most have rightfully seen us as liberators, saving Malaya from exploitation at British hands, others have taken up arms against our government, the colony has been stuck in a perpetual cycle between the military government, and the rebels. While our most recent operation has reclaimed Shōnan and all ports from their illegitimate government, we have information that they have stretched their hands for the Americans of all people.

It's clear that the situation in South East Asia is escaping our control, and harsher measures must immediately be taken, starting with squashing Chin Peng and the UMAJF once and for all, before we turn towards the Philippines, and their own little rebel problem too.

Hawaii might have been an overstretch, but the Pacific belongs to us, and we will not let this afront to our hold in the Pacific stand.
strings.JAP_meeting_with_generals_SHO: Meet With the Generals of the {sho_getflag} 25th Army
strings.JAP_wac_desc:
The West African Union is not an ideal ally. They are distrustful, display questionable ideologies, are internally unstable, and their ambitions of Pan-Africanism are dangerous. Yet even if they dislike us, they hate the western colonists more. If we want to deny a powerful OFN pawn, then the Pan-African cause must be supported.

We have escalated the war by {WAC_escalation}%.

{usa_getflag}{usa_getadjective} Garrison Strength: [?USA.USA_wac_garrison_strength]%
strings.JAP_WAC_shipment_trigger: We are not currently sending another shipment.
strings.JAP_WAC_defend_gulf_of_guinea_available_: The Gulf of Guinea has not been successfully blockaded.
strings.JAP_WAC_defend_gulf_of_guinea_failure_tt: Aid to the PALF will be made significantly more difficult.
strings.JAP_WAC_defend_gulf_of_guinea_success_tt: Our supply line to the PALF will stand.
strings.JAP_WAC_build_up_ports_tt_1: Our operational capacity in West Africa will be greatly expanded.
strings.JAP_WAC_build_up_ports_tt_2: It will become possible to expand equipment shipments to the PALF.
strings.JAP_WAC_station_task_force_available_tt_: We have built up the Union's ports.
The PALF controls the port of Èkó.
strings.JAP_WAC_station_task_force_tt: We will be able to conduct more naval operations.
strings.JAP_WAC_increase_naval_patrols_tt: Our convoys will be better protected while the patrols last.
strings.JAP_WAC_retrofit_fishers_desc: While the West African Union might not have an actual navy, and building one up would take years, they can still feasibly threaten lone OFN ships near land with torpedo boats. By taking some common fishing and civilian boats and arming them with torpedoes and machine guns, and giving them better engines and some protection, we'll go a long way towards threatening OFN operations in the Gulf of Guinea.
strings.JAP_WAC_naval_helicopters: Transfer Naval Helicopters to the West African Union
strings.JAP_WAC_prepare_offensive_campaign_desc: The Americans, French, and local allies are largely fighting in hostile territory. We will coordinate with our African allies to plan a behind the lines offensive to strike their supply lines and damage their morale. Once it has been launched, it will be up to our frontline troops to capitalize on this confusion and break their forces.
strings.JAP_WAC_prepare_offensive_campaign_missi: The Americans, French, and local allies are largely fighting in hostile territory. We will coordinate with our African allies to plan a behind the lines offensive to strike their supply lines and damage their morale. Once it has been launched, it will be up to our frontline troops to capitalize on this confusion and break their forces.
strings.JAP_WAC_prepare_offensive_campaign_tt: We will begin to plan an Christmas Offensive.

The offensive will commence!

(All nations at war with {cao_getnamewithflag}):
 Add Christmas Offensive, which grants (Division Recovery Rate: [?JAP.WAC_campaign_morale|=+2%], Division Organization: [?JAP.WAC_campaign_org|=+2%], Army Organization Regain: [?JAP.WAC_campaign_org_regain|=+2%], Stability: [?JAP.WAC_campaign_stab|=+2%]) for [?JAP.WAC_campaign_duration] days.
strings.JAP_WAC_preparing_campaign_action: Is currently taking an action to plan for the upcoming capaign.
strings.JAP_WAC_campaign_boost_morale_effect_tt: The impact of the campaign on enemy Division Recovery Rate will increase.
strings.JAP_WAC_campaign_boost_org_effect_tt: The impact of the campaign on enemy Division Organization will increase.
strings.JAP_WAC_campaign_boost_org_regain_effect: The impact of the campaign on enemy Army Organization Regain will increase.
strings.JAP_WAC_campaign_boost_stab_effect_tt: The impact of the campaign on enemy Stability will increase.
strings.JAP_WAC_campaign_boost_duration_effect_t: The duration we expect to keep up the campaign will increase.
strings.JAP_WAC_expand_shipments_available_tt: We successfully defended the Gulf of Guinea.
strings.JAP_angola_civil_war_desc: Angola has fallen into civil war, and the OFN has already intervened. Left unchallenged, they will assimilate yet another nation into its imperial fold. We must not allow this. Should the PLUAA succeed, not only will we defeat American imperialism, but gain a valuable ally - and a gateway into the continent.
strings.JAP_GZCW_PW_desc:
Mozambique has fallen into chaos with the victory of Samora Machel in the young nation's elections. Samora Machel is a socialist, and far from a true friend of Japan, but we have already come to an agreement with him to help him restore his broken nation in exchange for economic and political concessions. The Americans will no doubt back the opposition, who has risen up in armed conflict to try to oust Machel and install their own dictator in its place, so it falls to us to protect the Machel regime and our interests in not only Mozambique, but all of Africa as well by extension, blunting the tip of the Yankee sphere in Africa in the process.

Devastation is: [?ZZZ.mozambique_devastation|2]%
Mininium Increase is: [?ZZZ.mozambique_devastation_exponential_min]%
Maximum Increase is: [?ZZZ.mozambique_devastation_exponential_max]%

Every 3 weeks devastation will increase by a number between the min and the max. Should Devastation surpass 100%, Mozambique's civil war will grind to a halt and superpowers will be forced to withdraw.
strings.JAP_WAC_preparing_offensive_desc: Due to our logistics being directed towards a recent offensive, for the time being we can't begin planning for any new large scale offensive.
strings.JAP_WAC_offensive_cote_divorie_desc: We will prepare what is, hopefully, one final offensive to knock the Free French out of this war. By taking and holding Côte d'Ivoire, the rump imperialist state of France will surely be unable to continue standing, and their allies shall surely fall alongside them.
strings.JAP_Madagascar_desc:
Politics makes for strange bedfellows. In fighting for the liberation of the peoples of Madagascar from imperialism, we rely on the assistance and intelligence of the Americans. We must leverage this intel in
such a manner as benefits us while containing
American influence to the
best of our ability.
strings.JAP_MADCW_Distribute_Weapons_Supplies_tt:
Guns from former {ger_getflag} German armories and {usa_getflag} American weapons are located in this strategic node. We will seize the weaponry in this node and disperse it among our volunteers and government forces.
If a government friendly to the United States controls the strategic node, then American weaponry can make its way to the node through certain contacts.“ #
strings.JAP_utilize_guerrilla_tactics_tt: Guerrillas in this node will ramp up their activties, weakening German control of the surrounding countryside.
strings.JAP_Authorise_Terror_Bombing_tt: We may carry out more bombing operations simultaneously.
strings.JAP_Deploy_Defoliants_tt: Our bombing operations will become more devastating.
strings.JAP_INS_is_doing_naval_bombardment: Is currently carrying out a naval bombardment.
strings.JAP_INS_not_exceeded_bombing_limit: We have not exceeded our state bombing capacity of [?JAP_INS_max_bombings|0].
strings.JAP_Anti_Bandit_Operations_tt: Anti-Bandit Operations will reduce Resistance and increase Compliance in every state controlled by Japanese-aligned forces.
strings.JAP_PHI_PW_1_desc:
The Philippine insurgency is perhaps the longest-enduring conflict the IJA has ever had the dishonor of quelling, matched perhaps only by that in Malaya. A posting in the islands often spells the death knell of every glory-hound and careerist, for their jungles promise only malaria and a .50-caliber cure. Further hampering any lasting success are the budget cuts of ministries past, dwindling the once-formidable 14th Army's numbers into a glorified garrison - a trend only recently stymied by the damnable rebels' resurgence.

Nevertheless, the archipelago's importance is rarely overstated. For the Pearl of the Orient secures not just our sea lanes to Indonesia but also our grand bulwark against the American leviathan. A loss now will leave our lands and seas exposed once more to Western intrusion; Heavens know what will happen from there.

Thankless and bloody our job may be, but it is necessary. Let's get to it.
strings.JAP_last_stand_of_the_orient_pearl: The Last Stand of the Orient Pearl
strings.JAP_PHI_morale_lowers: The {phi_getflag}{phi_getname}'s' Morale Rises as The Insurgents Become Exhausted
strings.JAP_create_3_divisions_manila_PHI: 3 Japanese divisions will be shipped to Manila.
strings.JAP_increase_maximum_bombings_PHI_3: We can now bomb 3 states at the same time.
strings.JAP_training_schemes_buffs: Increases the {phi_getflag}{phi_getname}'s Defense and Organization by 10%.
strings.JAP_last_stand_of_the_orient_pearl_buffs: Increases the {phi_getflag}{phi_getname}'s defense and entrenchment speed by 10% and 15%.
strings.JAP_PHI_morale_rises_tt: Morale will rise. Improving the Military Performance of our ally.
strings.JAP_not_exceeded_bombing_limit: We have not exceeded our state bombing capacity of [?JAP_PHI_max_bombings|0].
strings.JAP_PHI_PW_2_desc:
The 14th Army returned home with ashes in their mouths and the ashes of their comrades in tow. Wails of families bereft of sons, fathers and brothers mingled with grudges oathed in anguish. No more mercy, said a youth in a recruiting station; no more half-measures, said an old man brandishing his old tasseled guntō. So say Japan as one: vengeance for the dead. Vengeance for their heroes.

In two months' time we shall depart to reclaim the Gods-forsaken islands once more. Until then, we must decide which divisions to bring.
strings.JAP_PHI_supply_text:
Our current £GFX_PHI_supply_texticon Supply is {JP_PHI_supply}/100
The invasion's £GFX_PHI_supply_floor_texticon Minimum Supply is {JP_PHI_supply_perc}
strings.JAP_PHI_preparations_custom:
Using these decisions, we can assemble the landing force to retake the Philippines. The number of Divisions we can send is limited by Supply.

The 14th Army is currently equipped with
{JAP_PHI_Army} divisions. An efficient landing force has at most 10 divisions.
strings.JAP_PHI_ongoing_custom:
We must make sure that the Supplies are enough to sustain the 14th Army until the end of the campaign, lest they will receive negative effects.

The Outcome of the 14th Army's campaign will be decided in six months.
strings.JAP_14_army_IJN_support_tt: The 14th Army will be stronger in the Early days of the conflict in the north, aided by the IJN.
strings.JAP_14_army_IJAAF_support_tt: The 14th Army will receive planes to use in the invasion, as well as giving us access to mass bombard enemy targets.
strings.JAP_PHI_PW_3_desc:
The men demand vengeance, and vengeance shall be delivered. The 14th Army has been ordered to retake the Philippine Islands once and for all. Every last detail has been meticulously accounted for to make sure nothing could go wrong. The battle lines have been drawn, and for now, we can do no more than watch and hope for victory.

{get14armycampaignstatus}Currently, our supply decays at a rate of {JP_PHI_supply_decay}
strings.JAP_14th_ceasefire_tooltip: Within the next six months, the outcome of the campaign shall be decided...
strings.JAP_PHI_14th_Army_send_tanks: Ship Tank Eq. to the {fgb_getflag}14th Army
strings.JAP_PHI_you_fucked_up_tt: At this rate, we will be forced to withdraw our forces completely from the isles. We must capture Maynila to improve the outcome of the campaign.
strings.JAP_PHI_small_victory_tt: At this rate, we will be able to secure most of Luzon, but nothing more. To further improve the outcome of the campaign, we must capture the region of Silangang Bisayas.
strings.JAP_PHI_half_victory_tt: At this rate, we will be able to secure most of the Philippines. To truly achieve victory in this war, we must secure The Island of Mindanao.
strings.JAP_PHI_full_victory_tt: We have secured victory! Now, we must hold out and tire the remaining enemy forces until the end of the campaign to fulfill our victory.
strings.JAP_PHI_reconstruction_desc:
The failure of the Balintawak Blitz has brought us ever further into solidifying our position as the sole master of all of Asia. Though their rebellions have collapsed, the damage that they inflicted is here to stay, and is costing the Filipino government a fortune to clean up, which if they're not careful, could spell economic and societal disaster within the country.

Thus, we have elected that we will bring aid for our Filipino brothers in many shapes and forms, be it money, medical equipment, construction, or even weapons to clean up any remaining resistance fighters.

However, we have been warned that the tension in the islands are very palpable, and that a failed reconstruction campaign may warrant unforeseen consequences. We must be wary.
strings.JAP_PHI_disallow_rebel_encirclement: We have disbanded the militias and the constabularies.
strings.JAP_PHI_disallow_rebel_encirclement_tt: Choosing this decision will disallow us from performing anti-guerrilla sweeps by ourselves, which may hinder the process of reconstruction in some way.
strings.JAP_PHI_disallow_disband_militia: We have committed to hunt down the rebels ourselves
strings.JAP_PHI_disallow_disband_militia_tt: Choosing this decisions will disallow us from disbanding the militias and the constabularies.
strings.JAP_PHI_Commit_More_Forces_desc: The formation of the United Front has forced us to adapt our invasion plans. An expansion of the supply network planned to support our invading army may be warranted.
strings.JAP_PHI_Training_Excercise_desc: To not prepare is the greatest crime. We will organize training exercises to prepare our forces for the coming invasion, though this will inevitably cost us equipment and supplies, our troops will greatly benefit from them.
strings.JAP_PHI_REC_Oli_1: We exploited an opportunity to expand our ties with the KALIBAPI Industrialists
strings.JAP_PHI_REC_Dem_1: We exploited an opportunity to expand our ties with the KALIBAPI Parlamentarians
strings.JAP_PHI_Assist_Reconstruction_desc: We will directly send aid to the government of the Philippines for reconstruction in many forms, be it material or monetary.
strings.JAP_PHI_Send_in_Experts_desc: We will send several experts in economics to help the Republic in its long road to recovery. Their aid is sure to be beneficial to the reconstruction and may even provide us with opportunities to innovate at home.
strings.JAP_PHI_Exploit_Local_Businesses_desc: We will assist the government of the Philippines in their reconstruction so long as they'll give our corporations favorable access to their markets.
strings.JAP_PHI_Promote_Loyal_Democracy_desc: We will start campaigns to teach our valiant allies in the Philippines the values of a proper pan-asian democracy. Of course, we will make sure the democracy that takes roots in the Orient Pearl will not stray away from the cause of co-prosperity.
strings.JAP_PHI_Support_the_Loyalist_desc: Mr. Paredes is the erudite kingmaker of the Republic, a champion of Laurelism, he will legitimize the Republic by furthering the reforms of his predecessors. Pan-Asianism will be bolstered by his efforts, as such we will assure his victory.
strings.JAP_PHI_The_Loyalist_tt: We will support Quintín Paredes securing our Interests
strings.JAP_PHI_Support_the_Industrialist_desc: Mr. Osmena Jr. is known for his technocratic approach to governance and reformist mindset, his ties to Japanese businesses make him by far the candidate most aligned with our interests and thus the one we should ensure wins, by any means necessary.
strings.JAP_PHI_The_Industrialist_tt: We will support Sergio Osmeña Jr. securing our Interests
strings.JAP_demobilize_militias_desc: With the militiamen and constabularies having already done their job, we do not have any more need of them. Keeping them organized is a waste of resources that can be used somewhere else, thus, militias and constabularies that have been ever useful for us during the war shall now be disbanded.
strings.JAP_dismantle_manila_forts_desc: The many fortifications in the city of Manila is an unfortunate sight to see. Along with its horrible look, it also hinders the process of reconstruction by taking up space that can be used for more useful buildings or infrastructure. Thus, a demolition and clean-up is in order.
strings.JAP_emergency_price_fixing_laws_desc: The economic situation in the Philippines is at a critical, with the war-torn country struggling to feed and provide the people with their needs as a result of decades of endless war. We must impose emergency price fixing laws to ensure that the people suffer the least, and to ensure that the economic situation does not degrade further.
strings.JAP_anti_rebel_encirclement_campaigns_de: With our militias on the islands, we will launch numerous campaigns targeted to eliminate rebel holdings within the jungles of the Philippines ourselves. This will aid in reconstruction immensely by eliminating threats to the regime.
strings.JAP_anti_rebel_encirclement_campaigns_su: The hunt against the remaining rebels in the Philippines succeeds.
strings.JAP_anti_rebel_encirclement_campaigns_fa: The hunt against the remaining rebels in the Philippines fails.
strings.JAP_Strengthening_Military_Presence: Strengthen Military Presence in the SPR
strings.JAP_Scour_for_Oil: Scour the South China Sea for Oil
strings.JAP_IBW_PW_desc: Iberia has largely been irrelevant to us, but a fledgling state called the Rif Republic has emerged in the Moroccan territory, and requested our aid. With access to the Atlantic and Africa, it is an opportunity worth taking to help them in their struggle.
strings.JAP_ircw_category_desc:
Once one of the few allies belonging to Germany in the Middle East, Iran has recently imploded into civil war following the death of its Shah, Mohammed Reza Pahlavi, a largely unpopular figure following his overthrowing of Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh and establishment of his pro-German regime. As the instability of the region has been threatening to boil over since the beginning of the Oil Crisis, it seems only natural that with the death of its leader, the partisans of Iran have made their move for power.

Among these rebels moving against the government of Iran are the Democratic Republic of Iran, led by Karim Sanjabi, the Socialist Federation of Iran under Iraj Eskanderi, and the Baluchi Liberation Front, an independence movement in the south of the nation led by Sher Mohammed Marri, among others. Of course, there is also the remnants of the pro-German government holed out of the north of the nation.

As fresh arms flow into the region, and the anti-German alliance already shows cracks, it would seem as though it's in the best interest of the world powers to send aid the way of their preferred candidates.
strings.JAP_Plane_Bombing_desc:
The outbreak of war with the Japanese puppet has brought the wrath of the Japanese Air Force down upon us. Bombs rain down upon critical infrastructure and military installations and our ability to offer resistance in the air is minimal.

This will disrupt the organisation of our forces and will damage domestic support for the war effort, but we have little choice but to press on and hope that this bombardment does not escalate further.
strings.JAP_military_advisors_desc: Our friends in Japan have seen fit to dispatch advisors from the IJA to aid our armed forces in the current conflict. With their support we shall see a significant improvement in the overall performance of our soldiers, as well as learning important lessons about modern warfare which will improve the efficiency of our armed forces in the future.
strings.JAP_technician_aid_desc: Japan has seen fit to dispatch technicians to aid our war effort and we are already seeing significant benefits to a range of different areas of our military and economy as a result. We can only hope that such aid continues to be forthcoming.
strings.JAP_sabotage_effort_desc:
The outbreak of war with the Japanese puppet has resulted in Japanese spies being unleashed against us. A wave of sabotage has swept our country as their agents set to work stealing state secrets, sabotaging military operations, and assassinating officials.

This is proving detrimental to the war effort, not only because of the direct consequences of the sabotage but also because of the paranoia gripping our government as our own agents struggle to prevent further damage.
strings.JAP_partisan_attacks_desc: Partisan attacks are being carried out with alarming frequency and efficiency behind our lines. Targeting our troop concentrations and lines of supply, these attacks prevent our ability to resupply our troops and effectively hold ground. The highly focused nature of these attacks makes it clear Japanese the Japanese intelligence services supporting our enemies are feeding intel to these groups. We will be able to drive them out, however until we do we must remain vigilant.
strings.JAP_army_infiltration_desc: Our Army has been infiltrated by Japanese Intelligence. Either through bribes or coercion, a number of out high ranking officers are feeding intel to our enemies. Until we can root out these spies our ability to plan offensives and coordinate troop movements will be hampered.
strings.JAP_mano_campaign_desc:
Our cohorts in anti-imperialism, the Pan-African Liberation Front, has excelled thus far in West Africa; their defeat of the 'Free' French, even backed by the OFN, proved the righteousness of our cause. Western avarice is no match for the armed wrath of the oppressed. Now, with the Oil Crisis raging, and the PALF relatively unaffected, they have seized the opportunity and struck at the last bastions of imperialism: Sierra Leone and Liberia.

Both ourselves and the OFN are impacted by the Oil Crisis, but the Americans have still thrown what they can spare into the conflict. If the PALF fais now, West Africa will continue to be threatened by the colonialist boot - we cannot permit that. One last effort to dislodge the imperialists, and the region will be freed at last... and firmly within our sphere.

strings.JAP_CCW_desc: Colombia lies in ruin; the fragile peace that the nation has been in for the last decade has melted, and Colombians once again fight with blade and rifle for what they believe in. Colombia lies directly in the United States' backyard- and we are presented with the unique opportunity to humiliate them within it. By supporting the Italian-backed Nationalist Front against the so-called legitimate government and the socialists, we can establish a great staging ground for operations in Latin America- right near the United States. It is important that we do not squander this opportunity.
strings.JAP_colombia.1.d:
To the Office of the Prime Minister,

Ever since the untimely end of President Gaitán in 1954, the South American nation of Colombia has been in a state of civil war and strife, with only a thin ceasefire agreement keeping a lid on the boiling pot, and the pressure is reaching its boiling point. Across the country are dens of bandits, corrupt leadership, communists, and worse. The United States, the so-called guardian of the Americas, has demonstrated its inattentiveness and incompetence with its inability to quell the chaos. As such, the Colombian crisis provides us with a unique opportunity to show both the strength of the Sphere and the weakness of the OFN by defeating the giant in its backyard.

Fortunately, our Italian allies have created a suitable candidate for our support in the State of New Granada. Led by an Italophilic Nationalist Front, the ruling ANP stands opposed to communists and liberals alike. Many among their ranks think highly of our Empire and would welcome our support. While disdain for our Empire runs high, pragmatism triumps and economic ties with the regime have proven profitable. A priority thus lies in the Alántico Department, which controls a vital port from which our geo-political rivals intend to send arms to their puppets and through which our Italian allies can ship much aid. Its capture would cripple their re-armament campaigns.

With your approval, we can begin operating immediately.
strings.JAP_colombia.1.a: The Rising Sun will shine over the Andes.
strings.JAP_colombia.2.d:
To the Office of the Prime Minister,

As predicted, tensions in Colombia have escalated to the point of open, if limited, skirmishes in the country's north. Although the fighting has been fierce, our efforts have borne fruit as paramilitary forces from our allies in New Granada have succeeded in seizing the Northern Departments and holding it against hostile counteroffensives. This victory has provided their troops with a morale boost and has left their opposition bereft of secure supply lines, a most decisive victory for the nationalist cause in Colombia.

However, while the opposing forces have been dealt a severe setback, our intelligence reports that an escalation of the conflict is imminent and we must further prepare New Granada for the ceasefire's end. The nation's terrain and the ferocity of enemy guerrillas will prove a difficult challenge for our forces and allies. Still, our advisers and contacts are confident that our victory is but an inevitability.
strings.JAP_colombia.2.a: A great victory, greenlight more support.
strings.JAP_colombia.3.d:
To the Office of the Prime Minister,

As predicted, tensions in Colombia have escalated to the point of open, if limited, skirmishes in the country's north. Despite the aid we have provided for them, New Granada's forces have been forced to turn back from the North empty-handed. Between the rough terrain and heavy opposition from the enemy, their forces could not crack hostile defenses, and thus the port cities and the enemy's supply lines shall remain out of reach for now.

Because of this failure, we can expect our rivals to continue funneling aid to their pawns unmolested, with a more difficult challenge ahead of us. Although unfortunate, our supply lines to the New Granadan forces remain solid via the Pacific, and their leadership is still committed to victory over the opposition. Our advisors at home and on the ground still believe that success is well within reach and recommend we escalate our support in preparation for the ceasefire's end.
strings.JAP_colombia.3.a: Regrettable, but we must secure our foothold.
strings.JAP_INDCW_desc:
Originally established by Indian exiles in Singapore as a vehicle for national liberation, the government of Azad Hind represents our interests in the Indian subcontinent. Biweekly flights between Tokyo and Kolkata carried ambitious marketing executives seeking new markets, while Foreign Ministry strategists weighed its potential as a naval outpost in future conflicts. Yet, they overlooked the smoldering embers left behind—a flame ignited by Japanese military officers during the war that was now beginning to take hold.

This flame, the enduring spark of a free India, had never truly gone out. It had waited patiently, its embers biding their time until they could catch. Now emboldened, this raging fire is poised to set the whole subcontinent ablaze, unless it is extinguished by force.

This fight for liberation could see the transformation of a remote outpost on the Empire's edge into a central stronghold. The fierce desire for an independent India has been thwarted time and again by American and German imperialism working in tandem. But with fuel to burn and one final push, this flame could bring liberation to yet another corner of the world from the grip of colonialism and imperialism.
strings.JAP_AZH_empty_space_desc: Most £GFX_decision_icon_small decisions to aid the {getindiancwside} will cost them their own £stability_texticon stability, so use your decisions wisely.
strings.JAP_AZH_start_blockade_desc: The Americans send weapons to support their neo-colonial regime in India, we may blockade to frustrate their imperial designs. The blockade's effectiveness, however, will be determined by our previous performance in Malaya and Madagascar.

-------------
Some prominent Mexicans care far more about yen than would-be Salvadoran revolutionaries. Anything we want to know about the Castrists, Major Onodera will ask.
strings.JAP_SalvadoranCoup_DirectSales_desc:
-------------

El Salvador's coffee oligarchs are desperate to defend themselves from marauding peasants. We can undermine their reliance on the Rivera government, and earn a good deal, by selling them surplus arms.
strings.JAP_SalvadoranCoup_RootCoffeeAgency_desc:
-------------
Using this decision reduces the effect of our actions on the Day of {els_getflag} Reckoning.
-------------
The Coffee Agency, our Latin American intelligence, must make Salvadoran connections. These local go-betweens will increase our efficiency... and hide our presence.
strings.JAP_SalvadoranCoup_AgainstWashingtonStoo:

This decision targets the lower of Civilian Anger and Military Preparedness, growing more powerful with FBI involvement in El Salvador.
